# Health (cms-api)

<!-- module-flows:start (generated by .claude/bin/module-index; do not edit) -->

Flows: [`public-site`](../../flows/public-site/FLOW.md).

<!-- module-flows:end -->

## Purpose

The two probe endpoints the cluster and the web status card poll. Liveness answers as long as the process runs; readiness also pings the core database and answers 503 when it fails. Neither ever returns internals (SPEC §6).

## Techniques

A use case behind a port: `CheckReadinessService` calls `DatabaseHealth.ping` with a 2 s bound, so a probe never hangs; the Prisma adapter is bound to `DATABASE_HEALTH` in the module. The failure message goes to the log only.

## Technologies

NestJS; Prisma (through `PrismaService`).

## Entry points

`GET /api/v1/health/live`, `GET /api/v1/health/ready`; export `HealthModule`.

## Where to change what

Another readiness dependency: a new port next to `DatabaseHealth` in `CheckReadiness.service.ts` and its adapter in `adapters/`; keep the answer `{ status }` only and the per-check timeout.
